 SPECIAL REPLAY: Matt Spielman – Inflection Points May 26, 2022

 I’m excited to share that Matt
Spielman, my friend of 25 years, a member of my personal Board of
Directors, and my executive coach, released his first book earlier
this week. It’s entitled: Inflection Points, How to Work and Live with
Purpose , and Matt gave me the honor of writing the
foreward to the book.

In an effort to help him spread the word, we’ve replayed my
conversation with Matt from last year in the feed. Have a listen,
and hop on Amazon to grab a copy.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
